description: An order represents a customer purchase, tracking status, timestamps, and delivery details.

attributes.customer_id: Identifier of the customer who placed the order
attributes.order_status: Current fulfillment status of the order
attributes.order_purchase_timestamp: Timestamp when the order was purchased
attributes.order_approved_at: Timestamp when the order was approved
attributes.order_delivered_carrier_date: Date the order was handed to the carrier
attributes.order_delivered_customer_date: Date the order was delivered to the customer
